text: Ah, yes. The candle. A marvel of modern engineering, really. It is primarily composed of wax, that miraculous substance harvested from the rendered fat of slaughtered animals or the crushed bodies of insects, or sometimes just melted-down plastic bottles if you’re feeling particularly eco-conscious in a way that doesn’t actually help the environment. This wax is then held together by a string, which is technically a wick but let’s call it what it is: a fuse for your boredom. The whole point of this setup is to burn the wax slowly so you can stare at the flame and pretend you’re having deep thoughts, when in reality you’re just wondering if you left the stove on. It’s a beautiful metaphor for life: you are slowly consuming yourself to provide a tiny, flickering light that no one is really looking at, all while the string holding it together is slowly turning to ash. Truly, a masterpiece of existential dread wrapped in a pretty jar.
